from app.api.handlers import handle_validate_email
import pytest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock

@patch('app.api.handlers.validate_email')
def test_validate_email_ok(mock_validate):
    mock_validate.return_value = MagicMock(normalized="test@example.com")
    assert handle_validate_email({"email": "TEST@EXAMPLE.COM"}) == (200, {"valid": True, "email": "test@example.com"})

@patch('app.api.handlers.validate_email')
def test_validate_email_invalid(mock_validate):
    from email_validator import EmailNotValidError
    mock_validate.side_effect = EmailNotValidError
    assert handle_validate_email({"email": "invalid-email"}) == (400, {"valid": False, "error": "invalid email"})

def test_validate_email_missing():
    assert handle_validate_email({}) == (400, {"valid": False, "error": "invalid email"})
    assert handle_validate_email({"email": 123}) == (400, {"valid": False, "error": "invalid email"})
EOF
